verses.1: And the heavens and the earth, and all their creatures, became quiet.
verses.2: And God completed on the seventh day what He had created. On that day, He rested from all His work.
verses.3: And God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy. For on that day, all the work that God had created to do, would be resting.
verses.4: These are the heavens and the earth, created on the day that Jehovah God created them. The earth and the heavens!
verses.5: And all the plants in the fields will not grow until it becomes a land again. And all the grass in the fields will not grow until it is planted, because God has not yet made the earth fertile for people to cultivate it.
verses.6: And it shall rise from the earth and fill all the land with its presence.
verses.7: And God created man from the dust of the ground. He breathed into his nostrils the breath of life, and man became a living being.
verses.8: And Jehovah God planted a garden there from the beginning. And He placed there the man who He had created.
verses.9: And Jehovah God created from the earth all kinds of trees that were pleasing to look at and good for eating. There were also trees that brought life, and trees that contained wisdom—both good and bad.
verses.10: And a river flows out from the garden to irrigate it. From there, it divides into four branches.
verses.11: The name of that one person is Pishon. He is the one who waters all the land where gold exists.
verses.12: And the gold of that land is good there; it’s better than stone and wood.
verses.13: And the name of the second river is Gihon. It flows through all of the land of Kush.
verses.14: And the name of the third river is Hidkel. It flows in front of Ashur. The fourth river is Prtah.
verses.15: And God took the man and placed him in the garden of Eden, so that he might serve and take care of it.
verses.16: And Jehovah God commanded man, “From all the trees in the garden, you may eat.”
verses.17: And from the tree of knowledge, good and evil cannot be eaten from it. For on the day you eat from it, death will come upon you.
verses.18: And the LORD God said, “It is not good for man to be alone. I will create for him a helper who will assist him.”
verses.19: And God created from the earth all kinds of living creatures in the fields and in the heavens. He brought them to man so that he could see what they were called. And whatever name the man gave to these creatures, those names became their names.
verses.20: And the man called out to all the animals, to the birds in the sky, and to all living things in the land. But no one could find any help against him.
verses.21: And Jehovah God made a hole in the ground, and he laid down there. Then he took one of his ribs and closed it with flesh.
verses.22: And Jehovah God created the rib from which He took a woman from man. Then He brought her to man.
verses.23: And the man said, “This time it’s completely out of my control. I can’t do anything about it. So, a woman will be taken away from her husband.”
verses.24: Therefore, a man shall leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and they shall become one body.
verses.25: And both of them remained calm. The man and his wife, and they did not get angry at all.
